## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the Wuff task or agreed feature brief.

## Scope

List any changes to database/schema, permissions/auth, API contracts, dependencies,
shared design tokens/global styles, CI or deployment. Write “None” if none apply.
Explain any departure from the agreed feature scope.

## Preview

Link the Vercel preview when available and give simple steps to try the feature.
Use synthetic data. Confirm the preview backend is isolated before testing writes.

## Verification

Record commands/checks actually run and their results. For UI changes, include
phone/desktop screenshots and relevant keyboard, loading, empty and error states.
Distinguish local/build evidence from live, native/device and production evidence.

## Remaining work or risks

List unverified behavior, technical help needed and any rollout/migration steps.
Database migrations and production releases require maintainer handling.
